content:
sophie (product): Publishing the Onprem Data Classification & Handling Guidance (v1) today. Purpose: give CSMs and engineers a clear playbook for customer labeling, tenant roles, and required agent flags. Docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/onprem-data-classification. Please skim and flag blockers.

raj (security): Key points: formalize PII/PCI/PHI labels, mandatory encryption-at-rest for labeled tenants, and a minimal auditor checklist. Added sample labeling taxonomy in section 2.

emily (cs): For customers: can we add a quick 'what this means for you' bullet list? Ops tickets spike when we introduce new wording.

sophie (product): Yes — will add a 1pager for customers. Plan: SMB summary + enterprise checklist.

mike (legal): Note: adding a default "sensitive" classification will require a short contract amendment for data processing terms. Draft in appendix A. Sales must attach for new orders.

trent (engineering): Tech notes: agent 3.5+ supports enforced classification via tenant metadata and will block non-compliant egress if `classification_enforce: true`. Example config snippet: 

```yaml
tenant:
  id: "tenant-123"
  classification: "sensitive"
  classification_enforce: true
```

ops-bot: Doc publish queued: onprem-data-classification-v1 -> staging (CI #5109). ETA 90m. :clipboard:

emily (cs): Also request: include standard support responses for customers who ask to reclassify data mid-contract. We need runbook + escalation path.

raj (security): Added: reclassification requires a signed attestation and a 14-day review window for high-risk labels. See section 5.

sophie (product): Action items: @trent add exact agent flag docs + rollback guidance; @mike finalize amendment language; @emily draft customer FAQ + canned responses; @raj add auditor checklist. Tracker: https://internal.redwood/tracker/CLASS-9. Close comments unless blockers. :white_check_mark:
